subject: Private Offer onboarding & MAP proposal for BlueMarble Health
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@bluemarblehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluemarblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private offer intake — procurement details and timeline

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — BlueMarble is seriously interested in running a pilot with Redwood via an AWS Private Offer. Procurement asked me to capture the gating items and an expected timetable so we can align our purchasing sprint with our internal security/compliance review. High-level notes from our side:

- Purchase vehicle: AWS Marketplace Private Offer (we will issue a PO to the vendor on receipt of private-offer acceptance link)
- Expected PO timeline: target sign-off within 6 weeks (procurement gate is SOC 2 + invoice path confirmation)
- Billing: invoice to BlueMarble Health (PO# BM-4507), prefer monthly invoice, but open to annual prepay if pricing benefits justify it
- Security evidence needed: SOC 2 Type II report, data handling summary, egress controls (we will run our security questionnaire in parallel)
- Evaluation: 45-day pilot, ~3 dev users, 50k tokens/month estimate for evaluation phase

Could you share a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation + procurement milestones and the typical steps you take on the AWS Private Offer side (who sets up offer, expected time to activate once PO is issued, billing flow)? If you have a template MAP and the list of typical attachments/legal items you need, that would help speed procurement.

Attaching a short doc with our internal checklist.

Thanks —
Aisha Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager
BlueMarble Health
[Attachment: BM_requirements_and_PO_guidance.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@bluemarblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer intake — procurement details and timeline

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Attached is a first-cut mutual action plan and a short billing note that maps how we typically handle AWS private offers. High level summary here so procurement has something concise to track:

MAP (proposed milestones):
1) Week 0–2: Pilot kickoff (credentials + test dataset, evaluation success criteria) — Redwood provides test account, access docs
2) Week 1–3: Security evidence exchange (SOC 2 Type II, data handling summary). We will assign our security contact if you need a call.
3) Week 2–4: Commercial review (pricing, term, PO details). We provide SOW + invoice template.
4) Week 3–6: Procurement issues PO; Redwood raises AWS Private Offer once PO and billing details confirmed. AWS activation usually within 48–72 hours after offer acceptance depending on AWS processing and SKU mapping.
5) Week 4–10: Private offer live; pilot progresses to production/scale if acceptance criteria met.

Billing path (typical):
- Customer issues PO to Redwood Inc. (we bill via AWS Marketplace private-offer invoice flow)
- Invoice is raised monthly against the private-offer usage, or can be annual prepay if you prefer (we can show TCO differences)

I've attached: redwood_private_offer_map_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), and a CSV of our common AWS private-offer SKU layout (aws-private-offer-sku-list.csv).

Next steps:
- Marissa (Sales Ops) — can you confirm we can accept PO# BM-4507 and whether we need any special billing fields?
- Ben (Marketplace) — can you confirm expected time to allocate SKU on the AWS side and any hands-on steps with the AWS account team?
- Aisha — once we have PO details (bill-to, remit address, any special billing codes) we'll prepare the Private Offer and SOW for DocuSign.

Happy to hop on a 30m sync with procurement + marketplace if that speeds things up.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_private_offer_map_v1.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood private offer intake — BlueMarble MAP + asks

Marissa / Ben — forwarding BlueMarble's procurement note and our proposed MAP. Key asks below: 

Marissa: please confirm the exact remit/bill-to fields we need on the PO for AWS marketplace routing. BlueMarble prefers invoice-to PO# BM-4507 and monthly invoices. Also confirm whether our billing team needs any special vendor codes to map to their AP system.

Ben: please own the AWS Private Offer flow — we need SKU mapping and the expected lead time once we hand AWS the offer and PO. If we need to loop in our AWS TAM, flag here and I'll introduce.

Legal/ops: we will use the standard SOW + acceptance criteria in the MAP; Marissa, if you can draft the first SOW with the 45-day pilot acceptance criteria (success: model generates X quality metrics / latency below 250ms p50), that will unblock procurement.

I attached the MAP and SKU list. I plan to propose the following timeline to the customer: pilot start this month, procurement sign-off in ~4–6 weeks, private-offer activation within 72 hours of PO acceptance. If either of you foresee blockers, call it out and we can adjust.

Thanks —
Jonas

Subject: Re: Private Offer onboarding & MAP proposal for BlueMarble Health

Thanks Jonas — this looks good and aligns with our procurement sprint. A few clarifications before we lock dates:

1) AWS Private Offer link: can you share the actual acceptance link (or let us know if Redwood will create the offer and we accept it)? We need that to pass to our AP team for review.
2) SOC 2: thanks for the pointer. Please send SOC 2 Type II report and a short data handling summary to security@bluemarblehealth.com — they will triage and come back with any follow-ups.
3) Pilot term: agreed to a 45-day evaluation. Procurement prefers a 1-year contract with a 30-day termination window after pilot acceptance. Please include that in the SOW.
4) PO details: Bill to: BlueMarble Health, PO# BM-4507, remit-to: 123 Finance Way, Suite 200, Boston MA 02110. Please confirm invoice cadence (monthly) and whether Redwood needs any vendor code.

If you can send: (A) Private Offer acceptance URL, (B) DocuSign SOW draft, and (C) SOC 2 + data handling summary by EOD Friday (Oct 13), procurement will target PO issuance the week of Oct 16. That meets our internal 6-week cadence.

Thanks —
Aisha Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager, BlueMarble Health
[Attachment: BM_requirements_and_PO_guidance.pdf (resent)]
